Raw value, then the local (league × group) and global (group across the pool leagues) percentile with its population size n. The registry basis is highlighted and drawn as the bar. Percentiles rank the raw value (high = more); the bar colour follows the metric direction, and style or team-influenced metrics are grey. >99 / <1 mark rows ranked against a population they are not in. A family's dimension score is the mean local percentile of its directional DNA members and says how many metrics it rests on.

DNA radar

League-local percentiles of the AM-Wingers' DNA metrics (ADR 004 §12): each player is ranked against the same group in their own league. Outward means more, not better. Directional axes are in ink (a lower-better axis says so); style and team-influenced axes are grey with a dashed spoke and carry no good/poor reading. Hover a vertex for its value.
